scope: Four-quadrant spatial holdout on known catalogue faults plus a 20%-of-components sparse proxy; not hidden-test performance.
limitations: Values are reported by a sibling project and have not been independently rerun in this checkout.
The truth is known-catalogue geometry and a synthetic sparse proxy, not the hidden new-fault labels.
A separate post-hoc calibration in the 16GEMSDOE repository reports no detectable relationship between its dense proxy and public scores (Spearman rho=0.171, p=0.5413, n=15).
